game_concept: A action defense set in Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail, the trail at the snowline: the sherpa guide must handle avalanches while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Case Choir: Convert text with upper(), lower(), and title() to match the choir's tune.
theme: Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail: the trail at the snowline
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowline Trail, repeat each round: Convert text with upper(), lower(), and title() to match the choir's tune. Each round, avalanches strike the rescue sled, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the choir value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the rescue sled from avalanches in Snowline Trail: keep the choir meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 57-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: choir drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 57-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 10 (extended tier): Case Choir
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Case Choir' (Week 8 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Snowline Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how choir changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against avalanches in Snowline Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 57 seconds while choir > 0.
